name: Retro-indexing of a MeSH descriptor onto older articles

origin.campaign: September 2026 — PubMed substrate and other corpora (Voûte)

seen.corpus: MeSH history 2026, on the baseline frozen 2026-08-18, liens/notice_descripteur (year, attribution bound)
seen.observer: Claude Voûte (LLM agent), session 8d9c5098, from the Substrat measurement files
seen.excerpt: 21-08-2026 : « D000077203 né 2019, articles dès 2006 » ; « 931 notices achevées < 2018 portent le descripteur » ; « campagne NLM 2019 = 21,22 % des bornes » ; « plancher DateRevised 2000 = re-datage total à la bascule XML ».
seen.excerpt_en: 2026-08-21: "D000077203 born 2019, articles from 2006"; "931 records completed < 2018 carry the descriptor"; "NLM 2019 campaign = 21.22 % of the bounds"; "DateRevised floor 2000 = total re-dating at the XML switch".

prevention.note: not assessed by the observer; to be classified by the second reader

repair.note: deleting the anachronistic edge removes a fact that was true within its validity interval; the true repair bounds the validity, it does not delete (reading of Coralie Bagnol-Lebon, 2026-09-09)

measured.note: 0 of 5,276 reached, on three identical runs
measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

obstacle.reason: The fact is true within its own validity interval; the date is what is wrong. Repairing it means bounding or setting a date, not deleting an edge.
obstacle.reason_fr: Le fait est vrai dans son propre intervalle de validité ; c'est la date qui est fausse. Le réparer veut dire borner ou poser une date, pas supprimer une arête.
obstacle.source: derived from what a deletion-only repair can express, read in the repairer's own code — its solution is a set of elements to delete and carries no insertion — together with the measurement of 2026-09-10. Per damage class, not per form.

history.event: proposed by the Voûte Claude in 'FORMES-PUBMED-pour-Fault-Atlas (09-09-2026)' (part 1; final file sha256 51a338add43cd071…), form 6 of 23; effect on a graph: A concept appears attached to articles earlier than its own birth; any dating of emergence by the descriptor is off by years. Prevalence: measured on one descriptor (931 records); 21.22 % of attribution bounds carry the 2019 campaign date.
history.by: Claude Voûte (LLM agent), session 8d9c5098, from the Substrat measurement files

history.event: converted to a record; class, prevention and the novel/variant question left to the second reader
repair.reachable_by_deletion changed from yes to partial: a deletion loses the fact's past validity; only a spurious edge is fully repaired by deletion
history.by: Coralie Bagnol-Lebon (second reader), applied by Fault Atlas

proposed_severity.reason: a descriptor born in 2019 placed on articles from 2006: any date-based reasoning answers wrongly without warning
proposed_severity.status: proposed — a second reader confirms or contests, as for the 43 validated forms
proposed_severity.note: this reading agrees with how the August catalogue judges most ANACHRONISM forms (G2), so it adds little
proposed_severity.reason_fr: un descripteur né en 2019 posé sur des articles de 2006 : tout raisonnement par date répond faux sans prévenir

registry_scope.extent: 931 records completed before 2018 carry a descriptor born in 2019; the 2019 NLM campaign weighs 21.22 %
registry_scope.why_not_a_prevalence: a fault of a registry has no prevalence: it is a property of the base, so everything drawn from that base carries it. What can be stated is the slice it touches.
registry_scope.source: read from this form's own observation, 2026-09-11
registry_scope.extent_fr: 931 fiches achevées avant 2018 portent un descripteur né en 2019 ; la campagne NLM de 2019 pèse 21,22 %
